description: Use when a U.S. lawyer asks what ethics duties apply to using generative AI. Gives a short, general summary of the duties covered by ABA Formal Opinion 512 (July 29, 2024): competence, confidentiality, communication, candor, supervision and fees. States adopt their own rules and guidance, so always tell the user to check their own jurisdiction.

topic.description: Which duty to explain, or all.

name: explain_ai_ethics_duties
title: Explain AI ethics duties for lawyers
